title: 5.5 Proving Triangle Congruence by SSS

icans: I can use SSS to decide whether two triangles are congruent.
I can use HL for right triangles.
I can write a proof that uses SSS.

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: can three sides wiggle?

blocks.p: Build a triangle with strips of 5, 7, and 9 cm. Try to change its shape. Compare with a neighbor.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: SSS Congruence Theorem: if three _______________ of one triangle are congruent to three sides of a second triangle, then the triangles are congruent.

blocks.stem: One triangle has sides 5, 7, and 9. Another has sides 9, 5, and 7. Are they congruent? Why?
△ABC has A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(0, 3). △DEF has D(5, 1), E(5, 5), F(2, 1). Are they congruent?
Given: A̅B̅ ≅ C̅B̅ and A̅D̅ ≅ C̅D̅.  Prove: △ABD ≅ △CBD.

notes: Hypotenuse-Leg (HL) Congruence Theorem: if the hypotenuse and a _______________ of a right triangle are congruent to the hypotenuse and a leg of a second right triangle, then the triangles are congruent.

blocks.stem: Two right triangles each have a hypotenuse of 13 and one leg of 5. Are they congruent? Why?
Why do bookshelves and bridges use triangle-shaped braces?
Are triangles with sides 6, 8, 11 and 8, 11, 6 congruent? What about 6, 8, 11 and 6, 8, 12?
Two right triangles each have a hypotenuse of 10 and a leg of 6. Are they congruent? Why?

tickets.stem: All three pairs of sides of two triangles are congruent. Which theorem proves them congruent?
Two right triangles have congruent hypotenuses and one pair of congruent legs. Which theorem?
In quadrilateral ABCD, A̅B̅ ≅ C̅D̅ and B̅C̅ ≅ D̅A̅. Why is △ABC ≅ △CDA?
